W1_symmetric_invariance.claim: A1-class ([U,SWAP]=0) twin statevectors identical -> any readout exactly 50% on twins (Lemma 1)

W2_generic_twin_distinguishability.label: random_kak
W2_generic_twin_distinguishability.metric: trace distance of frame-rotated reduced states on the two queried wires, per twin pair

W3_best_shared_linear_readout.label: random_kak
W3_best_shared_linear_readout.meaning: best UNRANKED traceless-Hermitian shared decision functional at fixed blocks (upper bound on the rank-2 effect-pair readout at those blocks); logistic regression w/o intercept on 15 Pauli features of rho_tilde

W5_affine_collapse_audit.label: random_kak
W5_affine_collapse_audit.meaning: relative Frobenius residual of the best affine model rho_no = alpha*rho_yes + c*I per twin pair; collapse (residual~0 with alpha>=0) is the ONLY way a single pair can defeat every effect pair (Lemma 2)
